The sequence involves bromination of cyclohexanone to give 2-bromocyclohexanone, which undergoes Favorskii rearrangement with NaOH to yield cyclopentanecarboxylic acid. This is converted to the acid chloride with SOCl₂/pyridine, then reduced with lithium tri-tert-butoxyaluminum hydride to cyclopentanecarboxaldehyde. In this molecule, the hydrogens are in four distinct environments: the aldehyde hydrogen, the methine hydrogen on the ring carbon bearing the aldehyde, the four equivalent hydrogens on the two adjacent ring carbons, and the four equivalent hydrogens on the two opposite ring carbons.
